text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 浅灰粗针织一字肩宽翻领长袖毛衣，黑色短裤，灰色过膝罗纹长袜，深灰大翻口麂皮中筒靴。。配饰：炭灰针织围巾披在臂侧。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Create one complete photorealistic wardrobe reference board on pure white. Image 1 is the approved hollow garment set: preserve exactly its clothing and footwear, colors, material and cut. Image 2 is the source board; target ONLY the largest central person in position r1c2. rNcM means row N column M, two rows four columns; ignore the tiny background thumbnails. Add ONLY these accessories: 炭灰针织围巾披在臂侧. Keep all detachable accessories separately alongside the garment set, one of each (earrings/gloves as pairs). Do not add any unlisted objects. Do not duplicate shoes or garments. No extra gloves, sunglasses, jewelry, bags or hats. No person, skin, feet, toes, body or visible mannequin; all shoes EMPTY and garment gaps white. All objects fully visible with generous margins. Portrait 2:3, soft neutral studio lighting, realistic fabric and metal. No labels, titles or watermarks.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
